forum.title: Review replicated design and feedback
forum.category: STM32 MPUs Embedded software and solutions
forum.content_text:
I have replicated the MB1936 Schematic for a dash-cam system based on the MP257FAIx series by choosing the relevant circuits from the reference to design my custom PCB. I would love to seek help from the community for the following requirement. If anything pops up my mind, I shall update on this thread -

1. Can I use the 5-pin MOLEX/JST GH Signal Connectors to interface the Waveshare IMX335 USB Camera Module? I have used the USB Host Port Architecture to implement my logic, and it has worked well.

Kindly find the Schematics PDF for your reference. Thank You!
